chunks.title: Paneer_Biryani_short_recipe
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Today I am going to show you how to make Paneer Biryani If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel First of all, we are going to cook biryani in cooker Add 1 tbsp of clarified butter in cooker When clarified butter is heated, add paneer cubes Now add paneer cubes in cooker Sprinkle some black pepper powder Add some salt Saute till colour starts changing Now add onion suddenly Paneer started changing its colour Now we will take it out in a plate. In the same cooker we will put oil. When the oil is heated we will put 4 finely chopped onions. Like we cut the onions for biryani. We will fry it when it is heated. Now our oil is heated. We will put 4-5 finely chopped onions. We will put 4-5 finely chopped onions. The main flavor of biryani comes from onions. Our onions have become light brown. Now we will turn off the flame and take it out. We will keep it inside for a while. In the same oil we will put whole spices. Bay leaf, cumin seeds, clove, cardamom, cinnamon stick. We will put all these in it. We will let the spices fry. We are making 1 glass of rice biryani. We will put 1 spoon of ginger, garlic and green chili paste. We will put a little more. We will mix it well. It is frying. Now we will tell you the dry spices. We will put 1 spoon of red chili powder. 1 spoon of coriander powder. 1 spoon of roasted cumin seeds. 1 spoon of biryani masala. 1 spoon of salt. 1 spoon of turmeric. We will mix all these in it. We will keep the flame low. We will put the rice. It is roasted. We will put 2 small tomatoes. We will roast it well. It is roasting. We have made a paste of 9-10 cashews. I had soaked it. We will put it. It gives a good flavor. Paneer biryani. I put it equally. We will keep stirring it. Otherwise, the cashews will stick to it. We will put the rice. Now we will turn off the flame. We will put curd in it. So that the curd does not burst. We will put 3 spoons of curd. We will mix it well. We will start it. We will cook it on low flame. We will mix it well. We will put 1 spoon of roasted dry fenugreek. We will put 2 green chilies. We will put chopped coriander and mint. We will mix it well. We are making 1 glass of rice. We will add water in it. Our masala is roasted well. We have just taken out 1 glass of rice. Do not wash it for a long time. We will put 1 glass of water in it. We will turn the flame high. We will put 1.25 glass of water in it. We are making it in a cooker. We will let it boil. We will put some lemon juice in it. We will put washed rice in it. We will mix it well. We will put fried onion in it. We will put fried cottage cheese in it. We will put fried green chilies in it. We will put lid on it. We will put it on 2 whistles. We have 2 whistles. We will put it on 1 whistle. After 1 whistle, when the pressure is gone. We will open it. Our biryani is ready. We will dish out it. Our biryani is ready. We are serving it with achari mirch. It tastes very good. I have already uploaded the video of biryani masala. If you like my recipe, please like it. Please subscribe to my channel. Thanks for watching.
